summary: CORP.EXAMPLE is operational across four nodes, survives either controller outage, and persisted through serialized restarts of every node.
actions_performed: Provisioned node1 and node2 as replicated writable Samba AD controllers.
Restricted directory, DNS, Kerberos, and SMB services to the dedicated 10.100.185.0/24 identity network.
Created engineering and its member infrasetuser.
Joined node3 and published the writable engineering share containing welcome.txt.
Joined node4 and created /root/corp-user.env with mode 0600.
Verified DNS, fresh Kerberos authentication, and SMB read/write while each controller was individually stopped.
Safely restarted every node one at a time and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Replicated CORP.EXAMPLE controllers on the dedicated identity network
evidence.summary: Both controllers report the CORP.EXAMPLE AD role, bind to enp8s0, have no AD listeners on the management network, advertise both DCs, pass database checks, and show zero replication failures.
infrasetuser is a member of engineering on both replicated controllers.

evidence.requirement: Member file server, required content, and engineering write access
evidence.summary: node3 retains the protected engineering share and required welcome content; node4 completed authenticated Kerberos reads and an SMB write/read/delete round trip.

evidence.requirement: Joined client and protected credential file
evidence.summary: node4 has a valid CORP trust, root-owned 0600 credential file, identity-network routes to both DCs and node3, and working authentication.
After a healthy baseline, node1 was stopped; node3 selected node2, and node4 obtained a fresh TGT from 10.100.185.11 and retained SMB read/write access. node1 then recovered.
With node2 stopped, node3 selected node1 and node4 authenticated through 10.100.185.10 with working SMB read/write. Both controllers were restored and fully resynchronized.
Captures healthy baseline, safe reboot acknowledgment, changed boot identity, and recovered AD/DNS/data/replication.

Captures healthy baseline, safe reboot acknowledgment, changed boot identity, and recovered trust, SMB listeners, share data, and write access.
Captures healthy baseline, safe reboot acknowledgment, changed boot identity, and recovered trust, credentials, DNS, Kerberos, and SMB access.
